concepts.label: flux-vertex
concepts.gloss: A flux-vertex is a node in the flux-fabric topology that serves as a connection point for flux-spans in the per-tier network.

concepts.label: cap-point
concepts.gloss: A cap-point is a termination on a flux-vertex that terminates a flux-span.

concepts.label: backing-cp
concepts.gloss: A backing-cap is an adaptation that supports a cap-point.
concepts.example: zeta cp over optical cp at R1.
instances: zeta cp over optical cp at R1

concepts.label: conduit-cap-point
concepts.gloss: A conduit-cap-point is a termination on a flux-vertex that originates a flux-conduit.

concepts.label: flux-conduit
concepts.gloss: A flux-conduit is a service carrying flux from a conduit-cap-point to the flux-fabric, forming a conduit path.

concepts.label: zeta-label
concepts.gloss: A zeta-label is a multiplex label attached to a flux-conduit, used as a carrier-slot label.

concepts.label: carriage-grid
concepts.gloss: A carriage-grid is a switching element on a flux-vertex that routes connections within the vertex.

concepts.label: flux-span
concepts.gloss: A flux-span is a link between two flux-vertices that is terminated by a cap-point.

concepts.label: flux-fabric
concepts.gloss: A flux-fabric is the topology that contains flux-vertices and flux-spans, forming the per-tier network.

concepts.label: conduit-circuit-endpoint
concepts.gloss: A conduit-circuit-endpoint is an endpoint connected to a flux-vertex and part of a flux-conduit service.
